newSession.title: Create new session
newSession.subtitle: Configure your workload step by step
newSession.noVolumes: No volumes available. Create one in Data / Volumes first.
newSession.localHomeHint: Mounts that physical node's local home as /home/work and pins the session to that node. Only nodes you have leased appear here.
newSession.homeModelHint: Home (~) is node-local and ephemeral (cleaned on session end). Save persistent data under ~/nfs. Datasets auto-mount under ~/datasets.
newSession.typeQuestion: How do you want to use the GPU?
newSession.tSharedDesc: Split one GPU by VRAM and cores. Economical for inference, notebooks, light training.
newSession.tExclusiveDesc: Occupy a whole GPU card. No interference — ideal for large training and benchmarks.
newSession.tCpuDesc: Run on the CPU pool without a GPU. Good for data download/preprocessing.
newSession.noSharedGpu: No shareable GPU available right now.
newSession.pickOfferingHint: Pick the size you need. Size is auto-classified by GPU share (%).
newSession.advancedDesc: Adjust VRAM and cores with sliders.
newSession.connByImage: Connection methods are determined by the image
newSession.sshKey: SSH public key (lets you SSH straight into the session)
newSession.aud2: Best for inference, small models, light practice
newSession.aud8: Best for standard training, notebooks, general dev
newSession.audBig: Best for medium training and large batches
newSession.nodeBusy: This node is already leased by another user. Pick a different node.
newSession.sessionLimit: You have reached the maximum number of concurrent sessions.
newSession.insufficientCredit: Insufficient credit. You need at least one hour's worth of balance.
newSession.surgeNote: May surge up to +{{n}} C/h when busy
newSession.envSshHint: Lease a physical node and use it directly over SSH.
newSession.sshDesc: Leasing a physical node gives you SSH access with your own account. Data is kept on the node local disk.
newSession.sshHomeHint: The home directory has a per-node size limit.
newSession.notifyRequested: You will be notified when available
newSession.nodeAutoHint: Let the scheduler place it without pinning a node.
newSession.dsAdvHint: Pick a node matching the GPU model, then choose datasets cached on it.
newSession.shareTierHint: Only 4 tiers are offered to prevent arbitrary slicing. CPU and memory scale with the GPU share.
newSession.tsSlotDesc: One GPU split into {{n}} slots, used in turns
newSession.guaranteeHint: CPU and memory are guaranteed in proportion to your GPU share. You may use more when the node is idle (it is a floor, not a cap).
newSession.grpGuaranteedDesc: Your VRAM share is guaranteed. Other sessions on the same GPU cannot take your memory.
newSession.grpSlotDesc: Several people take turns on one GPU. Memory is not guaranteed — if another session exhausts VRAM, yours can fail too.
newSession.notEnough: Not enough credit — 1 hour minimum required
newSession.homeSizeHint: Size of the session home (~). Leave empty for the default. It counts against your account storage allowance; {{remain}}GiB of that allowance remains (this is not free space on a node).
newSession.homeSizeHintNoQuota: Size of the session home (~). Leave empty for the default.
newSession.homeSizeOver: Exceeds your remaining storage ({{remain}}GiB). Reduce the size, or remove volumes or sessions you no longer need.
newSession.homeSizeLocalHome: Local Home uses that physical node's disk directly, so this value does not apply.

gpuReason.timeslice: Per-session GPU usage cannot be measured on time-sliced GPUs — utilization is only reported per physical card.
gpuReason.physical: Physical node leases have no container, so per-session GPU usage cannot be measured.
gpuReason.unavailable: GPU usage metrics are not available yet (still being scraped, or monitoring is not wired up).

session.detAutoStopDesc: Stops automatically after {{n}} min of GPU idle (saves credits).
session.reclaimHint: Stopped sessions still use home disk. After {{n}} days stopped they become reclaimable, and the longest-idle ones may be deleted when a node runs low on disk.
session.reclaimKeptHint: Your most recently stopped session is never reclaimed.
session.reclaimResumeHint: Restarting resets the clock. Please delete sessions you no longer need to keep.
session.idlePolicy: Sessions are auto-reclaimed after {{n}} min idle.
session.actionFailed: The request could not be completed
session.deleteWarn: This deletes the session. Stopping it instead keeps home intact.

reconf.title: Change resources — {{name}}
reconf.hint: Keeps your data and home directory; only changes the compute this session runs on next. Available while the session is stopped.
reconf.pinned: Shared GPU can only run on {{node}}, where this session’s home disk lives, so the choices are limited to that node’s GPU ({{gpu}}).
reconf.modeDesc_cpu: Downloads, preprocessing — work that needs no GPU
reconf.modeDesc_shared: A slice of a GPU (by offering)
reconf.noOffering: No shared offering exists for this GPU.
reconf.imageHint: Switching from CPU to GPU needs a CUDA image. Changing the image keeps home and volume data intact.
reconf.keepData: Home (/home/work), volumes and datasets are kept as-is.
reconf.startBlocked: No room on this node right now, so it cannot start immediately. Save the spec and restart once capacity frees up.
reconf.shareOff: GPU sharing (HAMi) is off on this node, so shared GPU is unavailable. Ask an administrator to enable sharing on it.
reconf.whyShareOff: GPU sharing (HAMi) is off on this node. Ask an administrator.
reconf.whyNoOffering: No shared offering exists for this GPU.
reconf.whyAllShared: This node is sharing-only, so a whole card cannot be assigned.
reconf.reallocWarn: This session is bound to the home disk on {{node}}. Starting it elsewhere requires wiping home.
reconf.reallocDone: Home wiped, started on another node
reconf.startBlockedElsewhere: No room on this node. Another node has capacity, so wiping home lets it start.
reconf.needsOtherNode: This spec cannot start on {{node}} right now. Another node has room, so wiping home lets it start there.
reconf.reallocNote: This cannot be undone. Move anything you need out of home first.

conn.title: Connect — {{name}}
conn.webConnectHint: Opens a terminal right in your browser (no SSH key or command needed).
conn.passwordHint: Initial access password. You can change it after logging in.
conn.portForwardHint: If the gateway is unreachable, run the command above and open the shown localhost URL.
conn.accessExpiry: This access link is valid for about {{mins}} min. Reopen if it expires.
conn.accessExpiryLive: Valid for {{time}} — reopen for a fresh link when it expires.
conn.accessExpired: Expired — reopen this dialog for a fresh link.
conn.sshVpnHint: While connected to the VPN (intranet), copy-paste the command above. It proxies straight through the gateway (MetalLB LB IP); the gateway handles auth (no key or password needed). Each command works once — reopen this dialog for a fresh one.
conn.sshHint: Just copy-paste the command above (the gateway handles auth — no key or password needed). Each command works once; reopen this dialog to get a fresh one.
conn.copyFail: Copy failed — select and copy manually
conn.loadFail: Failed to load connection info. Please try again.
conn.unavailable: This session does not offer that connection method.
conn.sshUnavailable: SSH is not available for this session (an admin must enable container SSH).
conn.sshExternalHint: From outside the campus network, use this command (jumps through a proxy host to the gateway).
conn.sshDirectHint: Connects directly to the node with your registered public key (campus network / VPN required).
conn.sshProxyHint: Connect through the single gateway entry point from anywhere. Once authenticated, the session stays connected (no periodic re-check).
conn.sshDirectInHint: Connect straight to the node from inside the office network — bypassing the gateway.
conn.sshNeedKeyHint: Register or generate one below — running sessions pick it up immediately.
conn.webConnectNewWindow: Opens a browser terminal in a new window — no SSH key or command needed.
